subject: Briefing + proposed 30-min intro windows — Redwood x Aurora Health
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Miles <jordan.miles@aurorahealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 3 Apr 2027 13:04:00 -0700
Subject: Briefing + proposed 30-min intro windows — Redwood x Aurora Health

Hi Jordan — great conversation today, thanks for walking through Aurora's primary goals for the next quarter. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we can lock in a 30-minute product intro (high-level + Q&A) with the right stakeholders.

Recap (from our discovery):
- Primary use case: inferencing historical clinical notes for indexing and retrieval; latency sensitivity for clinician-facing lookups (~sub-second preferred).
- Concern areas: data residency & on-prem options, audit logs, per-token cost forecasting.
- Success metric: reduce median inference latency by 30% vs current pipeline while lowering unit cost.

Suggested objective for the 30-min intro: show Redwood's hosted + private deployment options, expected latency profiles, and a short cost-per-query model for Aurora's typical payloads. We can then book a technical deep dive if that looks promising.

Proposed 30-minute windows (all ET):
- Option A: Tue, Apr 6 — 11:00–11:30 AM ET
- Option B: Wed, Apr 7 — 2:00–2:30 PM ET
- Option C: Thu, Apr 8 — 10:30–11:00 AM ET

If those don't work, please tell me 2–3 windows that do and which Aurora stakeholders you'd like on the call (CTO, platform lead, product owner, etc.). I've attached a one-pager and a draft mutual action plan that we can adjust after the intro.

Calendly quick link (if easier): https://calendly.com/redwood/30min-intro

Next steps: please confirm a preferred option or send alternatives. I'll create the calendar invite and include Stephanie (solutions engineering) for technical Q&A.

Thanks —
Ben
Ben Carter | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0182
Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood-one-pager.pdf; mutual-action-plan.xlsx

From: Jordan Miles <jordan.miles@aurorahealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 4 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Briefing + proposed 30-min intro windows — Redwood x Aurora Health

Thanks Ben — good summary and aligned on objectives.

Couple notes:
- The CTO (Priya Singh) and our platform lead (Marco Alvarez) should join the intro — Priya wants to see the high-level deployment options, Marco will focus on integration and data flow.
- We prefer a late-morning slot ET. Of your options, Thu Apr 8 late morning would be best but I see Option C is 10:30–11:00 AM ET which could work. If possible, Priya prefers 11:00–11:30 AM ET.
- Also: we will want to confirm whether private (VPC/on-prem) deployment is feasible for our compliance constraints before a full eval.

Availability from our side:
- Apr 8: 11:00–12:00 PM ET (Priya available 11:00–11:30)
- Apr 9: 9:00–10:00 AM ET (Marco available)

If you can propose 11:00–11:30 AM ET on Apr 8, we'll try to lock Priya in. If not possible, Apr 9 9:00–9:30 AM ET works.

—Jordan
Jordan Miles | Dir, Data Platform — Aurora Health
jordan.miles@aurorahealth.com | +1 (617) 555-0246

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Miles <jordan.miles@aurorahealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 4 Apr 2027 09:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Briefing + proposed 30-min intro windows — Redwood x Aurora Health

Perfect — thank you for the clarity, Jordan. 11:00–11:30 AM ET on Thu, Apr 8 works on our side and I'll hold that pending confirmation from Priya/Marco. For backup, I've put Apr 9 9:00–9:30 AM ET as the secondary option.

Planned agenda (30m):
1) 5m — quick intros + objective alignment
2) 12m — product demo focused on deployment modes (hosted vs private) and latency/cost examples for Aurora's payload sizes
3) 8m — platform/engineering Q&A (Stephanie will handle deep tech)
4) 5m — confirm follow-ups + next steps (MVP eval plan)

Stephanie — can you bring the short checklist on security/compliance and be ready to speak about Private deployment options and KMS integrations?

Jordan — I'll send a calendar invite with the 11:00–11:30 AM ET time and include a Calendly fallback if that time needs to change: https://calendly.com/redwood/30min-intro. HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/9876543 (I've added a task to follow up if Priya doesn't confirm within 24 hours).

If you confirm, I'll finalize the invite and attach the one-pager/mutual-action-plan.

Thanks —
Ben

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Jordan Miles <jordan.miles@aurorahealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 09:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Briefing + proposed 30-min intro windows — Redwood x Aurora Health

Thanks Ben — I'll join the 11:00–11:30 AM ET slot on Apr 8 and prepare a short security/compliance checklist covering:
- Private deployment architecture options (VPC, on-prem)
- KMS/HSM integrations and key rotation
- Audit logs & retained telemetry (retention windows we support)

Attaching a quick pre-demo checklist that I recommend sharing with Aurora ahead of the session so we can tailor the demo to their environment: pre-demo-questions.txt

See you all then.

—Stephanie
